name: The City Gate
summary: Glockmund's west gate. The last flow of people before the locks: farmers heading home, vendors packing up, merchant trains hauling goods. Two guards check papers and take the entry toll. The torches throw faces into light and shadow — and show who is lying.
affordances: State your identity, pay the entry toll
Haggle when overcharged (or let the Maestro intervene)
Watch the others coming in — perhaps one of your kind
danger: Garen the guard has a sharp memory. On a second entry, if your line doesn't match last time, suspicion rises.
